out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED PART OF THE WALL/BASEBOARD IN THE MOP SINK CLOSET IS IN NEED OF REPAIR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE REPAIR THIS BROKEN WALL/BASEBOARD AREA AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 81F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINK SHOULD MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED VEGETARIAN NUGGETS AT 114-117F AND CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 116-122F IN CAMBRO.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH RECEIVING TEMPERATURE LOG PROVING THAT CHICKEN NUGGETS WERE RECEIVED AT 152F AND VEGETARIAN NUGGETS WERE RECEIVED AT 150F 1.5 HOURS PRIOR TO INSPECTON. FOOD WAS SERVED WITHIN 30 MINUTES OF INSPECTION. CATERING COMPANY NORMALLY PROVIDES FOOD WITH A HOT PLATE. PLEASE ENSURE HOT HOLDING FOOD IS ALWAYS KEPT AT 135F.
